notes: Real-world injector test parameters. rail_bar=pressure in bar (EUI/EUP: rail_bar=5 cam-driven; HEUI: hydraulic actuation pressure). v2.3-2.6: cumulative fixes and additions. v2.7: +33 profiles — Toyota/Denso 1KD/2KD/1GD/2GD/4JJ1/ZD30/YD25/4M41, Bosch 0445110/115/010 series, Siemens PSA HDi/Ford TDCi, Delphi Ford/Renault/Sprinter/GM, CAT 320D/C6.6/3126, Cummins ISB67/ISF28/ISF38/QSB67, Scania DC09, Volvo D9 EUI, Bosch OM906 EUP. Total: 54 profiles.

CAT HEUI — hydraulically actuated, electronically controlled. rail_bar = IAP (Injection Actuation Pressure, hydraulic oil) in bar. IAP range: 35–207 bar (500–3000 PSI). Separate hydraulic oil supply required on test bench. C7: ACERT (2003+), C9: ACERT (2004+).
